title: cyperus lehmannii
intro: Cyperus lehmannii, commonly known as Lehmann's sedge, is a species of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is known for its health benefits, particularly in treating various respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus lehmannii include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and promote sweating, making it a popular remedy for colds and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
